title: Batman Arkham Knight #2 DC Comics 2015 Harley Quinn Panosian Cover Video Game
condition_description: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
description:

Back cover: Wrigley's 5 Ascent gum ad.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
